Description
Luxury furnished 2 bed, 2 bath + den executive condo in the heart of Kits. Thoughtfully appointed w premium furnishings, hardwood floors, gas fireplace, quartz counters, SS appliances & private home office. Spacious primary bedroom w queen bed & generous closet space, plus a beautifully furnished guest bedroom. Two spa-inspired bathrooms w Riobel rain showers & quality finishes. One secure parking stall included. Steps to West 4th shops, cafés, restaurants, transit, Kits Beach, Jericho Beach & an easy commute to UBC & Downtown. Rent $3995/month. Water, gas, internet (capped) & electricity (capped) included. Minimum 6-month lease (9–12 months preferred). Available September 1st w some flexibility. No pets. No smoking. References, credit check & tenant insurance required.

Description
Bannister Mews is one of the most distinguished townhome developments in Kerrisdale in recent years. Located at Arbutus and W.49th built within a retained and restored historic stone wall, this project combines architectural cues that exemplify characters of this historic neighbourhood with modern luxurious interior design. This 1,271sf, 3 levels, 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms townhouse features hardwood and engineered laminate floors throughout. Up the foyer to the main living area is the huge rectangular living room, dining area with ceiling fan and kitchen. The gourmet kitchen comes with shaker wood cabinetry, granite countertop, stainless steel Bosch and Fisher & Paykel appliances. Note: no more than two unrelated occupants are allowed for insurance restrictions reasons.

Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of an expansive rooftop deck, perfect for entertaining or simply savouring the picturesque vistas where breathtaking water, city, and mountain views await. Step into the private master suite offers a retreat-like ambiance with its spacious layout, walk-in closet, and lavish bathroom featuring a soaker tub and separate shower. Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.
